scope: One focused round: separate pre-transition forecasts from observable recovery; retain 3-state Kalman; evaluate robust measurement-noise estimation and velocity-change covariance adjustment.

hypotheses.kalman32_noise: Estimate measurement variance from normalized third divided-difference residuals; median of up to 9 residual energies, at least 5 before activation; Gaussian 2D median calibration by ln(2). Process noise remains the prior q=20/32^5 in the fixed input-coordinate units. This is an experimental calibration, not a device-independent guarantee.
hypotheses.kalman32_adaptive: Add the same noise estimator. If 2D normalized innovation exceeds chi-square(2,0.99), increase covariance along a velocity-jump direction [1,1/dt,0]; do not inject a known transition label or forcibly reset the acceleration mean.

acceptance: Keep pre-transition crossing errors separate from 0-16, 16-32 and 32-64 ms recovery errors.
Compare continuous reports and coordinate-change-only reports using identical query clocks and truth.
Retain improvements on real observed-next error and noisy motion; inspect clean curves and pause recovery rather than only pooled RMS.
Check numeric/state/budget invariants and measured computation time.
Freeze candidates before validation; do not score holdout. If still inadequate, retain the current default and prioritize physical-device collection.
